'''Berserker rakghouls''' were a mutated strain of [[rakghoul]]s that existed in the years of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Their notable traits were being more aggressive, violent and vicious to the point that they actively targeted armed convoys in order to feast on organic sentients or infect them with the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]].

Their existence came to light to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] when researcher [[Eton Vok]] observed their activities while studying rakghoul migration patterns and behavior. Vok thus coined the term berserker rakghouls based on their nature. He in turn tasked an Imperial official with eliminating the berserkers before they brought any further damage to Imperial forces.
